documentation: Rules for Greenhouse application forms (job-boards embed / MyGreenhouse apply). Within each list, the FIRST matching rule wins. For checkbox_groups, match is evaluated against the fieldset legend text only (normalized: lowercased, whitespace collapsed). Match keys mirror data/form_fill_rules.json: all_substrings, any_substrings, all_of_any, not_substrings, starts_with, regex (+ regex_ignore_case). choose_label is the visible option label beside the checkbox (normalized equality).

checkbox_groups.comment: How did you hear — applying via MyGreenhouse job search / board
